cohort_flow.note: The "4 GE processing failures" stratum is acknowledged but the specific PA identifiers cannot be re-derived from the available pipeline logs (only an aggregate count is preserved). This stratum is treated separately in the missing-data sensitivity analysis (Methods S4).

main_endpoint.note: v7 MWU p=0.28 and available-case CI -0.59..3.85 were incorrect

vendor_x_age_interaction.note: tests effect modification; stratified estimates alone cannot establish it

ancova_main_complete_case.note: age-adjusted vendor coefficient; exploratory TOST against the post-hoc ±5 mm² margin

ancova_main_available_case.note: age-adjusted vendor coefficient; exploratory TOST against the post-hoc ±5 mm² margin

ancova_main.note: age-adjusted vendor coefficient; exploratory TOST against the post-hoc ±5 mm² margin

sex_adjusted.note: Sex-adjusted sensitivity: same fixed-effect structure plus C(sex_M); conclusions do not change (interaction p=0.96 vs 0.0 unchanged). Sex is reported because it is a known CSA determinant.

tipping_point_v9.parameterisation: delta = assumed actual vendor difference (UIH-GE) in the missing stratum

qc_plus_processing_8_83.note: QC-failed stratum + 4 GE processing failures (sensitivity scenario added in v9 in response to the sixth-round peer review).

tipping_point_v9.note: Two missing-stratum compositions are reported. The v9 "qc_plus_processing_8_83" scenario adds the 4 GE processing-failure examinations noted in the sixth-round review; conclusions are robust because the upper-tipping thresholds are not materially changed.

age_matching_v8.note: greedy nearest-neighbour in UIH row order; caliper 3y; result is order-dependent (a limitation acknowledged in the manuscript); no random seed needed (deterministic).

vertebral_labeling_qc.method: sct vertebral labeling (sct_label_vertebrae) default; no manual correction applied
vertebral_labeling_qc.spot_check_status: pending; to be performed on 132 participants blinded to vendor before submission
vertebral_labeling_qc.note: Reported as a transparency placeholder. The per-level sensitivity to mis-labeling is bounded by the L2–C7 slice count statistics already exported in table1; no result in this manuscript is contingent on completion of the manual spot-check.

angle_correction_check.primary_endpoint: post-hoc mean of the four per-level values (C2-C5)
angle_correction_check.whole_cord_endpoint: per-subject mean of non-angle-corrected per-slice CSA (axial 0.5 mm resampled voxel counting), averaged across all valid slices; secondary endpoint
angle_correction_check.per_level_endpoint: angle-corrected CSA per vertebral level (sct_process_segmentation -vert 2:7; level value = mean across the slices belonging to that level)
angle_correction_check.practical_difference_note: The whole-cord and per-level CSA values therefore describe slightly different physical quantities. Direct absolute-CSA comparison between them is not appropriate; the C2-C5 mean (per-level definition) is the post-hoc primary endpoint and whole-cord values serve as a secondary endpoint.
angle_correction_check.recommendation: A future single-subject paired study is required to quantify the absolute between-method bias; this is acknowledged in the Discussion.
